title: Indiana University students and locals protest sexual violence on campus
seoTitle: Bloomington IU campus sexual violence protest

tea.why: Students and locals demonstrated against sexual violence on campus following an alleged rape case at Cornell University.
tea.want: Demonstrators called for greater transparency from the university regarding sexual violence.
tea.changed: Oct 20, 2026: WFHB reported on the campus demonstration held against sexual violence and for university transparency.

summary: Indiana University students and Bloomington locals gathered for the “I am Jane Doe” demonstration to protest campus sexual violence and demand greater transparency from the university. According to sources, the action was sparked by an alleged rape case at Cornell University and took place during the period known on campuses as the “Red Zone,” when students face a heightened risk of sexual assault. Reports noted that the Indiana University Police Department received multiple reports of sexual violence earlier in the semester. No official administrative response was detailed in the sources.
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Indiana University students and Bloomington locals held the “I am Jane Doe” protest against campus sexual violence.
WFHB reported that students and community members spoke out against sexual violence and called for university transparency.

sources.title: ‘Anyone can be a victim’: Complexities persist around sexual violence on college campuses
